domain.localValidityNote: Valid for arm_height in [5, 6] mm on the sealed isolated RadialArm bench case id01-radial-arm-bench.
limitations: Remeshing variation is included because each CalculiX solve remeshes independently.
The first-order-forward step equals the sealed proof mesh target size (1 mm) under sensitivity-study step compilation profile 1.0; it is not an agent-supplied number.
Metric ids are the exact Thread requirement feature radial_arm_bench_max_displacement_mm — the join does not invent aliases.
Support and load AABBs cover the union of the base and stepped RadialArm end faces plus the sealed 0.1 mm tolerance.
One 1 mm target mesh is not convergence evidence, and a 20% relative thickness step gives only a coarse local slope.
The isolated single-part 5 N bench and its derivative do not establish joints, the motor interface, airframe behaviour, flight, or certification.
